title: Powered three-arm run: rule, placebo, none
question: Does a one-sentence bug-fixing rule, delivered only as the work dir CLAUDE.md, change the pass rate of Sonnet on two bug-fix fixtures?

verdict.label: claim-allowed
verdict.text: DECISION (pooled rule-minus-placebo): CI excludes 0 (positive): 'rule helps' claim allowed

notes: n = 15 per arm per fixture, interleaved, 20 turns, subscription login.
The preregistered placebo is 12.8% shorter than the rule; see the preregistration.
